description:
## [1.28.0](https://github.com/dhrubonai/morphe-patches/releases/tag/v1.28.0) (2026-10-11)

### Bug Fixes

* **MovieBox - All-In-One:** fixed crash on launch. Rebuilt dashhook.dex from updated source files with JDK 21 + build-tools 37. The old precompiled dex was causing the patched 4.0.03 app to crash because it ran old extension code against new APIs. Telegram popup and coffee button preserved.
